name: YNX Docs
title: YNX Docs — versioned, recoverable documents for YNX
metaDescription: Create organized documents, recover offline conflicts, discuss exact versions, control sharing and review selected-context AI changes.
h1: Documents with visible versions, explicit access and recoverable conflicts
features: Account and expiring-link sharing with revoke
Markdown, HTML, JSON evidence and text export
Selected-version AI with apply or reject
boundaries: Document plaintext and versions are stored off-chain in the Docs/Cloud object service
YNX Chain may anchor identity, permission and hash evidence but is not a video or document byte store
Presence is bounded activity awareness, not character-level CRDT coediting
AI receives only the explicitly selected version after consent and never signs or silently overwrites
risks: Current source has no verified public deployment receipt
Historical public preview is not evidence for this source
Historical APK is debug-signed and not a current-source artifact
No production signing or store release
